# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 3 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_003_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 3

**3:1** And looking up toward heaven she saw a nest of sparrows in the laurel tree, and she made a lamentation within herself, saying:

**3:2** "Woe is me, who gave me birth? What womb brought me forth? For I was born a curse before the sons of Israel, and I have been reviled, and they have mocked me and cast me out of the temple of the Lord.

**3:3** "Woe is me, to what am I likened? I am not likened to the birds of heaven, for even the birds of heaven are fruitful before you, O Lord.

**3:4** "Woe is me, to what am I likened? I am not likened to the beasts of the earth, for even the beasts of the earth are fruitful before you, O Lord.

**3:5** "Woe is me, to what am I likened? I am not likened to these waters, for even these waters are fruitful before you, O Lord.

**3:6** "Woe is me, to what am I likened? I am not likened to the earth, for even the earth brings forth its fruit in its season and blesses you, O Lord."
